title: Internal dashboard search requests use FIELD_VALUES, not RESOURCE_TABLE
answers: Why does GetDashboardTags/searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw set ResultFormat to FIELD_VALUES?
Which fields can't be requested when ResultFormat is FIELD_VALUES?
Why was labels/updatedBy removed from the internal search field list?
How to add a new internal dashboard search field safely
body: Symptom: none reported by users; this is a preventive invariant for internal (non-paginated-UI) dashboard searches. Root cause: FIELD_VALUES is a typed result format that has no typed definition for resource.SEARCH_FIELD_LABELS or resource.SEARCH_FIELD_UPDATED_BY — those only existed in the legacy RESOURCE_TABLE format. Fix pattern: when switching an internal search request to ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES, strip any table-only fields from request.Fields via slices.DeleteFunc before sending (see dashboard_service.go:searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw), and keep GetDashboardTags's facet query on FIELD_VALUES too. Constraints: response PARSING must still branch on the server's actual returned format (RESOURCE_TABLE or FIELD_VALUES) to stay compatible with older search servers — only the outgoing request format/fields changed, not the parser.
applies: Any code building a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest for internal (non-/api/search) dashboard lookups in pkg/services/dashboards/service.

When switching an internal search request from RESOURCE_TABLE to FIELD_VALUES, strip table-only fields from request.Fields via slices.DeleteFunc before sending (see searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw), and keep GetDashboardTags's facet query on FIELD_VALUES as well. Response parsing must still branch on the server's actual returned format (RESOURCE_TABLE or FIELD_VALUES) to maintain compatibility with older search servers—only the outgoing request format and fields changed, not the parser. Applies to any resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest built for internal (non-/api/search) dashboard lookups in pkg/services/dashboards/service.
